build.description: Runs dotnet build or publish once over a traversal project of every batched project, MSBuild ordering them and reporting each project's result

check.description: Reads the SARIF 2.1 reports a project's compile wrote and fails on each warning or error no suppression answers, with no second compile

format.description: Runs dotnet format commands on one project, or once over a solution of every batched project written outside the workspace

upgrade.description: Moves a central package file's versions to the newest listed releases its consumers accept, then restores its projects with dotnet restore --force-evaluate

release-publish.description: Packs a project in Release and pushes its package with dotnet nuget push, skipping a project nx release left unversioned
